name: Bank Shot
design_intent:
TRIALS PHYSICS_PUZZLE proof course #2 -- the BANK SHOT capstone (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.6, example t_bank_shot; escalates past t_ball_cannon's direct line). The goal is NOT on a straight line from the ball: a fuse bomb PUNTS the resting Ball up-and-right, it arcs over and CAROMS off a tall vertical wall on the right, then banks DOWN-LEFT into a goal pocket set back on the left. Aim-by-explosion + read the ricochet. Clear-test = the SPORTS GoalZone latch (any goal_zone.scored). The Ball auto-resets to spawn on a miss (settles/leaves bounds) and each reset ticks the attempt counter; gold = solve first blast.

WHY IT BANKS (vs current Tuning: explosion_impulse_center override 1500, Ball mass 0.6 / restitution 0.85, gravity 1600): the Ball rests at (500,1000) on a marshmallow launch pad. The bomb at (400,1150) punts along (ball-bomb).normalized()=(0.555,-0.832), dist 180 => blast_radius 560 falloff 0.679 => 1500*0.679=1019, /0.6 => launch ~1697px/s = (vx 942, vy -1412). The Ball arcs to apex ~(1330, 377) then descends RIGHT into the vertical wall at x1600 (contacts its left face ~x1540, y~416), reflecting vx +942 -> ~-800 (Ball restitution 0.85) while keeping its downward vy. It then travels DOWN-LEFT and passes through the goal pocket (center 1180,820; a GENEROUS 300x520 mouth spanning x1030-1330, y560-1080) on the way down -- the intended one-blast solve. On the way UP the Ball crosses the goal's x-range ABOVE the mouth (y~377-459 < top y560), so it never scores prematurely; it only enters the mouth from above after the carom.

The player spawns on a LOW centre watch-pad (1000,1210), out of the bomb's kill_radius (dist ~600 > blast_radius 560, so no knock) and BELOW the ball path + goal mouth (pad top y1280 sits under the score band y560-1080) so it never blocks the shot -- no traversal task; the low-centre spawn frames the whole puzzle in the follow-camera (the ball's launch at x500 through the wall at x1600 all on-screen). The fuse recurs (~4s) so a missed shot re-fires after the auto-reset returns the Ball to spawn. The intended one-blast bank is the reasonable path; a player could in theory fly up and body-nudge the Ball, but the momentum-based ball-drive makes that no easier than letting the recurring blast solve it.

[HISTORICAL - v10 removed medals/par; binary completion] MEDAL (attempts, fewer better): gold 1 (first blast), silver 2, bronze 6. NOTE: medal thresholds OBSOLETE (v10 binary completion); bank geometry validated in-engine.
